expanded_wikitext:
This is a list of the 68 [[Power Moon]]s (66 regular Power Moons and 2 [[Multi Moon]]s) that can be found in the [[Luncheon Kingdom]] of ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''. {|class="wikitable sortable col4left col5left mario sm" style="width:100%;text-align:center" !!data-sort-type="number"|# !class="unsortable" width="192px"|Image !data-sort-type="alphabetical"|Name !class="unsortable"|Location !Availability |- |1 |[[File:TheBroodalsAreAfterSomeCookin.png|192px]] |''[[The Broodals Are After Some Cookin']]'' |Mario must defeat [[Spewart]] for the second time in the game to obtain this Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- |2 |[[File:UndertheCheeseRocks.png|192px]] |''[[Under the Cheese Rocks]]'' |Mario must make it to an area with [[Spiny|Spinies]], [[Hammer Bro]]s., and cheese rocks. He must capture a Hammer Bro and break a group of cheese rocks on a higher platform. Underneath these cheese rocks is a [[Lever Switch]] that Mario can throw Cappy on to unlock this Power Moon. |Available after collecting "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" Power Moon. |- |3 |[[File:Big Pot on the Volcano Dive In.png|192px]] |''[[Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!]]'' ❸ |Mario must make it to the Meat Plateau checkpoint and capture the large piece of [[meat]] found here. After twitching the salt off of him, [[Cookatiel]] will catch Mario and take him to a large pot with vegetables in it. The [[Multi Moon]] can be found at the end. |Available after collecting the "Under the Cheese Rocks" Power Moon. |- |4 |[[File:ClimbUptheCascadingMagma.png|192px]] |''[[Climb Up the Cascading Magma]]'' |Mario must make it to the Volcano Cave Entrance checkpoint. Inside the cave, Mario must capture a [[Lava Bubble]] and swim up a large hill of lava and [[Lava Geyser]]s. At the end, he must jump into the one unlit torch still as a Lava Bubble, which will make this Power Moon appear. |Available after collecting the "Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!" Multi Moon. |- |5 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 5.png|192px]] |''[[Cookatiel Showdown!]]'' ❸ |Mario must make it to the Start of the Peak Climb checkpoint. He must climb up the large mountain while avoiding enemies and obstacles such as Spinies and [[Pepper (obstacle)|peppers]] until he gets to the Top of the Peak Climb checkpoint. He must capture a Lava Bubble and launch himself from the [[lava cannon]] into a large pot where he must defeat Cookatiel. |Available after collecting the "Climb Up the Cascading Magma" Power Moon. |- |6 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 6.png|192px]] |''Piled on the Salt'' |The player can find this Power Moon on a mound of salt on top of one of the buildings near the [[Odyssey]]. |Available from the start. |- |7 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 7.png|192px]] |''Lurking in the Pillar's Shadow'' |The player can find this Power Moon in an alcove by dropping off of the building to the left behind the Peronza Plaza checkpoint. |Available from the start. |- |8 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 8.png|192px]] |''Atop the Jutting Crag'' |Near the Salt-Pile Isle checkpoint, the player must capture a Lava Bubble and find a lava cannon to launch himself in the air. Mario will launch over a platform and must decapture the Lava Bubble to land on it and collect the Power Moon. |Intended to be available after "Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |9 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 9.png|192px]] |''Is This an Ingredient Too?!'' |In the Peronza Plaza, the player can find a stack of [[crate]]s behind one of the buildings there. One of the crates contains the Power Moon, which will spawn on top of one of the buildings. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |10 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 10.png|192px]] |''Atop a Column in a Row'' |On top of one of the columns in the Peronza Plaza, the player can find a glowing spot. Mario must ground pound this glowing spot to obtain the Power Moon. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |11 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 11.png|192px]] |''Surrounded by Tall Mountains'' |By long jumping off the Meat Plateau, the player can find a glowing spot among one of the small green mountains. Mario must ground pound it to obtain the Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Under the Cheese Rocks" Power Moon. |- |12 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 12.png|192px]] |''Island of Salt Floating in the Lava'' |Near the Salt-Pile Isle checkpoint, the player can find another small island. The island has a glowing spot in the middle of it that Mario must ground pound to obtain the Power Moon. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |13 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 13.png|192px]] |''Overlooking a Bunch of Ingredients'' |If Mario jumps out of the pot that Cookatiel was fought in, he should land on a purplish blue mountain on the southwest side. At the end of the blue mountain, a glowing spot can be found which Mario must ground pound to obtain the Power Moon. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |14 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 14.png|192px]] |''Light the Lantern on the Small Island'' |At the Path to the Meat Plateau, the player can find a lantern sitting on a small island that they can light. It can be lit by either capturing a Lava Bubble and jumping into it or by capturing a Fire Bro and throwing a fireball at it. The Power Moon will appear after it is lit. |Available after collecting the "Under The Cheese Rocks" Power Moon. |- |15 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 15.png|192px]] |''Golden Turnip Recipe 1'' |Next to the [[Crazy Cap]] shop in Peronza Plaza, Mario can find a [[turnip]]. He must throw it into the large pot of [[Stupendous Stew]] in Peronza Plaza, which will grant him a Power Moon. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |16 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 16.png|192px]] |''Golden Turnip Recipe 2'' |East of where the "Atop the Jutting Crag" Power Moon is found, Mario can find a golden turnip. He must throw it into the large pot of Stupendous Stew in Peronza Plaza, which will grant him a Power Moon. |Intended to be available after "Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |17 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 17.png|192px]] |''Golden Turnip Recipe 3'' |At the Path to the Meat Plateau, Mario must capture a Hammer Bro and go behind the green mountain. A pile of cheese rocks can be found, which Mario must throw frying pans at to find a golden turnip underneath them. Mario must throw it into the large pot of Stupendous Stew in Peronza Plaza, which will grant him a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Under the Cheese Rocks" Power Moon. |- |18 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 18.png|192px]] |''Luncheon Kingdom Timer Challenge 1'' |On top of one of the buildings near the Odyssey, the player can find a [[Scarecrow (object)|scarecrow]]. Mario must throw Cappy on it and quickly collect the Power Moon that appears before the timer runs out. |Available from the start. |- |19 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 19.png|192px]] |''Luncheon Kingdom Timer Challenge 2'' |Behind the Peronza Plaza checkpoint, the player can find a scarecrow. Mario must throw Cappy on it and quickly collect the key that makes the Power Moon appear before the timer runs out. |Available after collecting the "Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!" Multi Moon. |- |20 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 20.png|192px]] |''Luncheon Kingdom Timer Challenge 3'' |Behind the Start of the Peak Climb checkpoint, the player can find a scarecrow. Mario must throw Cappy on it and quickly collect the key that makes the Power Moon appear before the timer runs out. |Available after collecting the "Cookatiel Showdown!" Multi Moon. |- |21 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 21.png|192px]] |''Beneath the Rolling Vegetables'' |At the Remote Island in the Lava, the player must enter the [[8-bit pipe]] and can find the Power Moon at the end of the 2D area. |Available after collecting the "Under The Cheese Rocks" Power Moon. |- |22 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 22.png|192px]] |''All the Cracks Are Fixed'' |At the Remote Island in the Lava, Mario must ground pound all six cracks in the ground to make the Power Moon appear. |Available after collecting the "Under The Cheese Rocks" Power Moon. |- |23 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 23.png|192px]] |''Taking Notes: Swimming in Magma'' |Near the Remote Island in the Lava, the player can find a rainbow-colored treble clef sitting in the middle of the lava. Mario must touch it and quickly collect all of the [[note]]s that appear before the timer runs out. |Available after collecting the "Under The Cheese Rocks" Power Moon. |- |24 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 24.png|192px]] |''Love Above the Lava'' |The player must capture a [[Goomba Tower]] and reach [[Goombette]], who can be found near the Odyssey by walking on a [[floating corn]]. Being near her will grant Mario the Power Moon. |Available from the start. |- |25 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 25.png|192px]] |''Shopping in Mount Volbono'' |The player can purchase this Power Moon from the Crazy Cap shop for 100 gold coins. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |26 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 26.png|192px]] |''Luncheon Kingdom Slots'' |Behind a pile of vegetables in the Peronza Plaza, the player can find a building which houses the [[Slots]] minigame. For this version, Mario must match up five Power Moons in a row to obtain the Power Moon. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |27 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 27.png|192px]] |data-sort-value="Strong Simmer, A"|''A Strong Simmer'' |The player must purchase the Chef Hat and Chef Suit from the Crazy Cap shop and then talk to a [[Volbonan]] blocking entry to a door to the left of the shop. Inside is a bonus area, where Mario must capture a Lava Bubble and jump into the pot of Stupendous Stew when he enters the area, which makes the Power Moon appear. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |28 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 28.png|192px]] |data-sort-value="Extreme Simmer, An"|''An Extreme Simmer'' |In the area where the "A Strong Simmer" Power Moon is found, Mario must capture a Lava Bubble again, but this time he must make it to the end of the area, where another pot of Stupendous Stew is found. Jumping into it as a Lava Bubble grants Mario the Power Moon. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |29 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 29.png|192px]] |''Alcove Behind the Pillars of Magma'' |In the area where the "Climb Up the Cascading Magma" Power Moon was found, the player can find this Power Moon by going behind the part where Mario drops off into a group of Lava Geysers into a hidden alcove. |Available after collecting the "Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!" Multi Moon. |- |30 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 30.png|192px]] |''Treasure Beneath the Cheese Rocks'' |Near the Odyssey, the player can find a pile of cheese rocks. To break the cheese rocks, Mario must capture a Hammer Bro at the Path to the Meat Plateau and then backtrack to the very beginning of the kingdom. Mario must then throw frying pans at them to find a glowing spot underneath them. Finally, he must ground pound the glowing spot to obtain the Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!" Multi Moon. |- |31 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 31.png|192px]] |''Light the Two Flames'' |Near the Odyssey, the player can find two lanterns that they must light using a Fire Bro to obtain the Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!" Multi Moon. |- |32 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 32.png|192px]] |''Light the Far-Off Lanterns'' |After passing through the Volcano Cave Entrance, the player can find two lanterns near the exit. By capturing a [[Fire Piranha Plant]], the player can spit fireballs at the lanterns. Once both lanterns are lit, the Power Moon will appear. |Available after collecting the "Climb Up the Cascading Magma" Power Moon. |- |33 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 33.png|192px]] |''Bon Appétit, Captain Toad!'' |Near the mountain that the player climbs to get to the boss fight against Cookatiel, the player can find [[Captain Toad]] situated on a small island that is close to the edge of the kingdom. Captain Toad will reward Mario with the Power Moon once spoken to. |Available after collecting the "Climb Up the Cascading Magma" Power Moon. |- |34 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 34.png|192px]] |data-sort-value="Treasure Chest in the Veggies, The"|''The Treasure Chest in the Veggies'' |Near the Path to the Meat Plateau, the player must jump on top of the wall to the right side of the checkpoint to find a door hidden behind the wall. Inside the door is a treasure chest containing the Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!" Multi Moon. |- |35 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 35.png|192px]] |''Caught Hopping at the Volcano!'' |At the entrance to the Peronza Plaza, Mario can find a [[rabbit]] that he must catch to obtain this Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Cookatiel Showdown!" Multi Moon. |- |36 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 36.png|192px]] |''Taking Notes: Big Pot Swim'' |In the giant pot that Mario fought Cookatiel in earlier, the player can find a rainbow-colored treble clef. The player must touch it and collect the three sets of notes that appear before the timer runs out to obtain this Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Cookatiel Showdown!" Multi Moon. |- |37 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 37.png|192px]] |''Magma Swamp: Floating and Sinking'' |Near the Peronza Plaza checkpoint, the player can find a door by dropping off the ledge behind the checkpoint. Inside the door is a room filled with lava and moving platforms as well as Moon Shards that Mario must collect to obtain the Power Moon. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |38 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 38.png|192px]] |''Corner of the Magma Swamp'' |In the area with the "Magma Swamp: Floating and Sinking" Power Moon, the player can find this Power Moon by going behind the entrance in the area where three sinking platforms are. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |39 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 39.png|192px]] |''Magma Narrow Path'' |Near the Meat Plateau, the player can find a door which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must capture a Lava Bubble and swim across several thin paths of floating lava to find the Power Moon at the end. |Available after collecting the "Under the Cheese Rocks" Power Moon. |- |40 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 40.png|192px]] |''Crossing to the Magma'' |In the area with the "Magma Narrow Path" Power Moon, the player can find this Power Moon above a "mountain" of lava to the right of two [[Magmato]]s. |Available after collecting the "Under the Cheese Rocks" Power Moon. |- |41 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 41.png|192px]] |''Fork Flickin' to the Summit'' |Near the Salt-Pile Isle checkpoint, the player can find a door which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must capture multiple Volbonans and "flick" his way up to the top of a mountain where the Power Moon is found. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |42 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 42.png|192px]] |''Fork Flickin' Detour'' |In the area with the "Fork Flickin' to the Summit" Power Moon, the player must use one of the Volbonans before the end of the area to flick Mario to another platform to the right side where this Power Moon is found. |Intended to be available after "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" but can be obtained from the start using skilled jumps. |- |43 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 43.png|192px]] |''Excavate 'n' Search the Cheese Rocks'' |At the Path to the Meat Plateau, the player must capture a Hammer Bro and go to the right side where a greenish blue structure is located. Behind the structure is a pile of cheese blocks blocking a door which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must collect five Moon Shards in a room full of cheese rocks. |Available after collecting "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" Power Moon. |- |44 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 44.png|192px]] |''Climb the Cheese Rocks'' |In the area with the "Excavate 'n' Search the Cheese Rocks" Power Moon, the player can find this Power Moon in a hidden alcove blocked off my a mountain of cheese rocks. |Available after collecting "The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'" Power Moon. |- |45 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 45.png|192px]] |''Spinning Athletics End Goal'' |Near the Remote Island in the Lava, the player can find a greenish structure which has a scarecrow to open a door, which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must make it through many rotating blocks to obtain the Power Moon found at the end. |Available after collecting the "Under the Cheese Rocks" Power Moon. |- |46 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 46.png|192px]] |''Taking Notes: Spinning Athletics'' |In the area with the "Spinning Athletics End Goal" Power Moon, the player can find a rainbow-colored treble clef on a lime green rotating platform. Mario must touch it and collect all of the notes that appear before the timer runs out. |Available after collecting the "Under the Cheese Rocks" Power Moon. |- |47 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 47.png|192px]] |''Secret Path to Mount Volbono!'' |This Power Moon can be found on top of the Floating Sky Island. To reach it, the player must travel through a painting located in a different kingdom: *If the player visits the [[Lake Kingdom]] before the Wooded Kingdom, then the painting can be found behind an iron block on the iron wall in the Wooded Kingdom, which can be reached by traversing atop the wall from the Station 8 checkpoint flag. *If the player visits the [[Wooded Kingdom]] before the Lake Kingdom, then the painting can be found in a small pool of water in the Courtyard of the Lake Kingdom. | *Available after collecting the "Flower Thieves of Sky Garden" Power Moon (Wooded Kingdom). *Available from the start (Lake Kingdom). |- |48 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 48.png|192px]] |data-sort-value="Tourist in the Luncheon Kingdom!, A"|''A Tourist in the Luncheon Kingdom!'' |After restoring the [[Sand Kingdom]], the player should locate the [[Desert Wanderer]] at the Tostarena Town. Mario must talk to the Tostarenan, who states that he wants to go to the [[Metro Kingdom]] and after talking to him there, he later travels to the [[Cascade Kingdom]]. After talking to him in the Cascade Kingdom, the player should head to the Luncheon Kingdom, where the tourist can be found at the entrance to the Peronza Plaza. Talking to him here will reward Mario with a Power Moon. |*Available after collecting the "A Tourist in the Cascade Kingdom!" Power Moon (Cascade Kingdom). *Available after collecting the "Cookatiel Showdown!" Multi Moon (Luncheon Kingdom). |- |49 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 49.png|192px]] |''Found with Luncheon Kingdom Art'' |At the Path to the Meat Plateau, the player can climb on top of the blueish purple mountain on the left side to find a piece of [[Hint Art]]. The Hint Art shows [[Poochy]] digging on a glowing spot on a small rock formation underwater in the [[Seaside Kingdom]]. If Mario travels to the Seaside Kingdom and ground pounds the spot shown by the Hint Art, he will be rewarded with a Power Moon. |Available after collecting the "Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!" Multi Moon. |- |50 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 50.png|192px]] |data-sort-value="Rooftop Lantern, The"|''The Rooftop Lantern'' |The player must capture a Fire Bro at the Path to the Meat Plateau and then backtrack to the Peronza Plaza. On top of one of the buildings there, a lantern can be found which Mario must light to obtain this Power Moon. |Available after defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom. |- |51 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 51.png|192px]] |''Jammin' in the Luncheon Kingdom'' |Behind the Peronza Plaza checkpoint, the player can find a [[Jammin' Toad]] opposite of the Scarecrow that activates the “Luncheon Kingdom Timer Challenge 2” Power Moon. Should Mario talk to the Toad, he will request that the player play a specific piece of music related to "I've become a monster!" The Toad will reward Mario with a Power Moon if the player selects the "Fossil Falls: Dinosaur", "Honeylune Ridge: Collapse", "Honeylune Ridge: Collapse (8-bit)", or "Honeylune Ridge: Escape" theme from the [[List of Super Mario Odyssey media|Music List]]. |Available after defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom. |- |52 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 52.png|192px]] |''Mechanic: Repairs Complete!'' |The player must purchase the Mechanic Cap and Mechanic Outfit from the Yellow Crazy Cap shop. Mario must then speak to a [[Steam Gardener]] that can be found on top of a green staircase in Peronza Plaza. The Steam Gardener will tell Mario that it needs a mechanic and will reward Mario with the Power Moon. |Available after defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom. |- |53 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 53.png|192px]] |''Diving from the Big Pot!'' |From the giant pot of Stupendous Stew that Mario fought Cookatiel in earlier, Mario must jump from there as a Lava Bubble into a smaller pot of Stupendous Stew found on top of a building in the Peronza Plaza. The Power Moon will appear after doing so. |Available after defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom. |- |54 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 54.png|192px]] |''Hat-and-Seek: Among the Food'' |Behind one of the buildings in Peronza Plaza, the player can find a Volbonan with a [[Bonneter]] disguised as a chef hat on its head. If Mario speaks to the Bonneter, he will be rewarded with the Power Moon. |Available after defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom. |- |55 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 55.png|192px]] |''Luncheon Kingdom: Regular Cup'' |Outside Volcano Cave, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon. |Available after defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom. |- |56 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 56.png|192px]] |''Peach in the Luncheon Kingdom'' |Peach can be found near the pot of Stupendous Stew in the Peronza Plaza and will reward Mario with the Power Moon when spoken to. |Available after talking to the Toad outside Peach's Castle (Mushroom Kingdom). |- |57 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 57.png|192px]] |''From Inside a Bright Stone'' |Behind the Peronza Plaza checkpoint and to the left side, the player can drop off the ledge and can find a blue rock with a glowing spot on it. Additionally, from where the Moon Rock was opened, Mario can capture a Lava Bubble and jump as a Lava Bubble to the blue rock. Mario must ground pound the glowing spot to obtain the Power Moon. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |58 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 58.png|192px]] |''Under the Meat Plateau'' |The player must capture a Lava Bubble and swim behind a green wall near the Meat Plateau, where the Power Moon can be found hovering above the lava. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |59 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 59.png|192px]] |''On Top of a Tall, Tall Roof'' |This Power Moon can be found on the roof of the entrance to the mountain peak where the two lanterns used for the "Light the Far-Off Lanterns" Power Moon are located. Due to its elevation, Mario should long jump/dive from the Top of the Peak Climb Checkpoint or from where the rolling pepper is launched. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |60 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 60.png|192px]] |''From a Crack in the Hard Ground'' |By jumping on the higher ledge to the right of the Path to the Meat Plateau checkpoint, the player can find two cracks on top of it. Mario must ground pound the crack west of the three regional coins to obtain this Power Moon. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |61 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 61.png|192px]] |''By the Cannon Pointed at the Big Pot'' |At the Top of the Peak Climb, the player can find a glowing spot on the orange rocks surrounding the lava cannon that launches Mario to the pot where Cookatiel was fought. Mario must ground pound the glowing spot to obtain the Power Moon. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |62 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 62.png|192px]] |''Luncheon Kingdom: Master Cup'' |Outside Volcano Cave, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock and collecting the "Luncheon Kingdom Regular Cup" Power Moon. |- |63 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 63.png|192px]] |''Stepping Over the Gears'' |At the top of the Meat Plateau, the player can find a [[Moon Pipe]] which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must avoid enemies such as Fire Bros and [[Bitefrost]]s while jumping across several rotating gears. |Available after opening this kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |64 |[[File:SMO Luncheon Moon 64.png|192px]] |''Lanterns on the Gear Steps'' |In the area with the "Stepping Over the Gears" Power Moon, the player must capture a Fire Bro and light all of the lanterns that appear in the area.
